# The hit of the implementer gets the first scoped fix. Two scoped reviews ask for changes, and each scoped fix carries the findings of the review before it.
# The third scoped review approves, the gate passes once, and the full review approves.
exec beehest run 7 --workflow flow/workflow.star
stdout 'item 7 finished'

exec beehest status
stdout '^item-7-r1\tdone\tgate pass at [0-9a-f]+\treview 4/24\t'

grep -count=1 '^plan ' calls.log
grep -count=1 '^implement ' calls.log
grep -count=3 '^fix 1 ' calls.log
grep -count=4 '^review ' calls.log
! grep '^fix 2 ' calls.log

cmp events.log expected-events.log

-- verdicts --
changes
changes
approve
approve
-- expected-events.log --
claim 7
release 7
